content.what_it_is: MATLAB workshop script computing wave spectra at three FUNWAVE-TVD gauge stations for the inlet_shoal case (resonance analysis). For each station file sta_0001..sta_0003 in ../saved_results/gauges/ (L3, L6, L19-L20): discards the first shift=1000 samples and takes column 2 (eta time series, L21), sets dt=1.0/0.5 (L22), Welch parameters noverlap=512 (L23), nfft=1048 (L24), nps=512 (L25, unused), window=bartlett(nfft/2) (L28; hanning and nfft=1048*4 alternatives commented at L26-L27), computes [pxx1,F]=pwelch(eta1,window,noverlap,nfft,dt) (L30), selects a per-gauge line style from p1='b-', p2='r-', p3='c-' via eval (L9-L11, L32), and plots spectral density versus frequency (L34) with axis [0 0.3 0 2] (L37), labels (L38-L39), legend 'gauge 1'..'gauge 3' (L44) and grid (L46). A semilogx alternative is commented at L35.
entities: eta loaded station time series L20
pstr selected line style via eval L32

equations.ref: trim spin-up and select eta column

unresolved: the variable named dt=1.0/0.5=2.0 (L22) is passed in pwelch's sampling-frequency argument position (L30); if the gauge output interval is actually 0.5 s the sampling frequency 2.0 Hz is correct but the name dt is misleading, and with the plotted band 0-0.3 Hz (L37) this cannot be resolved from the file alone

noverlap=512 equals the window length bartlett(nfft/2)=bartlett(524) only approximately (524 vs 512); pwelch semantics with noverlap smaller than window length are valid but the mismatch of nfft/2=524 vs noverlap=512 is unexplained
eval-based style selection (L32) instead of indexing a cell array
